rootCause: The Generator canonical sample service emits unqualified @CpfTransactional on CUSTOMER_BUSINESS_DB work. Mandatory Common correctly contributes its own transaction manager, so a complete Generated Domain has two legitimate owners and Spring cannot infer the business transaction boundary.
requiredFix: Update the Generator canonical sample scaffold to name cpfDomainTransactionManager on every generated business transaction, fresh-generate and compile, then exact-sync MBR/EXS from the Generator and repeat physical E2E.
prohibitions: Do not mark either transaction manager Primary globally
Do not remove transactionality or bypass AOP
